name: Monkie
summary:
Monkie is a VR horror experience that merges the chaotic freedom of Gorilla Tag locomotion with the relentless tension of survival horror. You awaken deep inside a remote abandoned research facility, your memory fractured, and echoing through the concrete halls. Something has gone horribly wrong.
